weekOutlook.summary: One of the more catalyst-dense weeks of the month. Mega-cap earnings collide with the Fed's preferred inflation gauge and GDP on the same afternoon. Wednesday and Thursday carry the real risk; Monday is comparatively quiet, and Friday brings headline risk from Jackson Hole rather than earnings.

catalysts.title: The biggest day of the week
catalysts.text: NVDA reports after close on the same day as PCE inflation data and the GDP second estimate. Macro and the market's biggest single-stock mover, stacked.

catalysts.title: MRVL reports + labor data
catalysts.text: MRVL after close, alongside weekly jobless claims and the advance goods trade balance. Second-biggest single-stock catalyst on the watchlist this week.

catalysts.title: Jackson Hole Symposium
catalysts.text: No major earnings, but Fed commentary here can move the entire market regardless of any individual name. Headline risk, not calendar risk.
